description:
Return the raw .page markup of a micropage project's active build (or of a given build number), plus its stored llms.txt and the filenames uploaded to the project.

Call it before editing an existing site: change the returned source and send the whole file back with save_page as landing.page. Pass `version` to read an older build, e.g. to restore it. The source was merged from all .page files when saved, so it comes back as one file.

Read-only; it does not show what is live (get_project tells you which build is deployed) and does not download images.

project.description: Which project: its uuid, its numeric id, its micropage hostname ("acme" or "acme.micropage.sh") or its custom domain ("www.acme.com"). A full URL also works. Get valid values from list_projects.

version.description: Which build's source to read: a build number ("v12" or 12) or id ("id:4567"). Defaults to the active build (the draft or published build the editor and CLI work on), else the latest build.

name: get_page_source

assets.description: Filenames uploaded to the project, usable as `img: <- filename`. Null if the list could not be read.

is_active.description: True when this is the project's active build.

build.description: Null when the project has no builds yet.

llms_txt.description: The site's /llms.txt as stored on this build, if any.

domain.description: micropage slug: the site lives at https://<domain>.micropage.sh.

source.description: The raw .page markup. Several files were merged into one when saved; edit it as landing.page.

title: Read a project's .page source
